milestones.label: Application deadline, doctoral programmes (2027 intake, general)
milestones.source_text: Zhejiang University's International College gives 28 February 2027 as the general closing date for doctoral applications for the 2027 intake; enrolment is expected in early September 2027.

milestones.label: Application deadline for doctoral programmes with a later cut-off
milestones.source_text: The same page says some programmes close later, on 31 May 2027, and tells applicants to check the programme catalogue.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Chinese Government Scholarship via the university (Type B)
milestones.source_text: The page names 31 December 2026 for the Type B university route. For the bilateral Type A route it gives no date and refers applicants to their home-country authority.
